Tau Autonomy Center offer functional test and training facilities for air and sea based autonomous drones and an infrastructure built specifically for testing purposes.

sentences.text: TAU AUTONOMY CENTER AS describes itself on its website as: "Tau Autonomy Center offer functional test and training facilities for air and sea based autonomous drones and an infrastructure built specifically for testing purposes".
TAU AUTONOMY CENTER AS is a private limited company (AS), founded on 2020-01-06, registered in Strand.
It reported revenue of NOK 433,980 for 2025 and an operating result of NOK 34,656 (2025).
TAU AUTONOMY CENTER AS is led by board chair Bjørn Aril Veland.
TAU AUTONOMY CENTER AS has a verified website (https://www.tauautonomycenter.no/) and 3 linked public profiles.
